about: Copies of Tamil Nadu State Board Class 12 question papers (public exams, district quarterly and half-yearly exams, PTA and DGE model papers) used by the Maja Space app. Each entry names the site it was published on and who shared it. Teachers' own model papers are not copied here; the app opens them from where their authors published them.
